title: Analytical Blank
applies_when: The technique has a measurable analytical blank. Omit where no blank exists (track counting, luminescence, most imaging).
sub_module_test: Run 2026-08-14 under Rule 6.15 during the ReportingCore dissolution. Footprint 12 consumers. Against the other three successors — TargetSelection: overlapping, neither contained; CalibrationFactor: subset; Aggregation: subset. No IDENTICAL relation, so prong 1 nominated no merger; TargetSelection and Aggregation are both 13 consumers but different sets, which is why co-extension had to be tested rather than assumed from the count. Subset of Core (16/16), which holds only fields universal to every TAPP and so cannot absorb a conditional one. Existing technique modules (LaserAblation, MCICPMS, SolutionIntroduction, Geochronology, UPb, ArAr) are all strict subsets and differ in subject.
notes: Was ReportingCore block 'blank'. Split out of Module_ReportingCore on 2026-08-14. ReportingCore was the only conditional module and the only one that was not all-or-nothing: 9 of its 16 consumers held all six fields and its five blocks had four different consumer footprints, so it was four independent modules sharing a file — bound by shared provenance (the geochronology specificity re-triage that produced them) rather than by structure. Each successor is unconditional and all-or-nothing, carrying its applies_when at module level where a reader will find it. Consumers select by composing the module or not, so 'one $def per module' holds again for every module in the library.
decisions: 2026-08-14 v1. Field text taken unchanged from Module_ReportingCore v6 — the dissolution moves fields between modules and changes no definition, so composition is a no-op and no consumer needs a version bump.
Compose AFTER Core: the Group 5 and 6 blocks anchor on 'Constants and Reference Values Used' and 'Additional Notes', both owned by Core.

2026-08-14: source_comment declared. Rule 6.11 originally withheld the label from the general modules as noise; with 12 modules supplying most of the library, naming the source of every field is what makes a composed TAPP readable. Documentation only — no structural meaning, not schema content.

2026-08-25: Step 1 of the Description/Purpose split. Column B keeps the Description sentences; the Purpose sentences moved to consumer-owned Column J. Move only — no text reworded or deleted. Routing and rules in analysis/Step1_Routing_ALL_MODULES_2026-08-25.csv.

2026-08-25: Column J `Purpose` declared as an OVERLAY column, not an owned one. The module supplies a default Purpose that a consumer inherits on composition and owns thereafter — the same relationship Column F already has. Added after Step 1 stripped Purpose sentences from Module_ArAr's descriptions with nowhere to put them, because ArAr is composed into no TAPP: a module with no consumer had no destination for its own Purpose text, so the text was lost. Modules now hold it themselves.
